e.title: Posit FSI 保险数据科学手册
e.summary: Posit（RStudio）金融保险数据科学手册：Snowflake 上 R/Python 规模化分析
e.body:
Posit Playbook for Financial Services and Insurance（posit.co）是 Posit（RStudio 公司）的金融保险数据科学手册：Snowflake 上 code-first、AI 驱动的数据分析规模化——R/Python 在保险数据科学的企业级实践。对 RIAA：保险数据科学的企业级指南——R/Python 生态（[[tidyactuarial]] 精算包 + [[duckdb]] 分析）在云上的规模化；理解「code-first 数据科学」的企业范式；配合 [[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps）做生产化；数据科学岗（保险方向）的行业手册。

e.body_en:
The Posit Playbook for Financial Services and Insurance (posit.co) is Posit (the RStudio company)'s FSI/insurance data-science playbook: code-first, AI-driven scaling of data analytics on Snowflake — enterprise practice of R/Python in insurance data science. For RIAA: an enterprise guide to insurance data science — the R/Python ecosystem (the [[tidyactuarial]] actuarial package + [[duckdb]] analytics) scaled in the cloud; understand the enterprise paradigm of 'code-first data science'; with [[insurance-mlops]] (MLOps) it supports productionisation; an industry playbook for data-science roles (insurance direction).
